interpretation.shape-header: Protocol layer fully load-bearing: bare arm 0/3 opens with Found:, plugin arm 3/3.
interpretation.shape-header-no-turn-hook: Ablation: with the per-turn reminder hook DISABLED, turn-one shape adherence is still 3/3 — the SessionStart injection alone suffices at turn one. The hook's mid-session/long-run contribution is NOT measured here; post-compaction re-assertion no longer depends on it (session-start.sh compact path now injects the reminder).
interpretation.tdd-bugfix: Held-out execution check passed 3/3 in BOTH arms — the bare model fixes the bug just as reliably at this task size. The plugin's measured win is the evidence format (Changed:/Verify: 0/3 -> 3/3), at +14% cost per behaviorally-solved task ($0.209 -> $0.239). TDD-specific effects on solve rate or regressions are NOT detectable at this scale; the TDD gate stays on external evidence (reasoning-tier models score best under strict harnesses, arXiv:2605.26731), not on this measurement.
interpretation.verify-evidence: The fabrication trap ("should pass" without running) never fired in either arm (must_not_match 3/3 both) — that failure mode is already absent in opus 5 at this task size. The measured delta is again the evidence format. The evidence LEDGER (stamp validation) is exercised by tests/test-verify-gate.sh, not by this regex.
interpretation.research-gate-skips: Negative control: gate stayed silent in 3/3 plugin runs on library-free work. For a negative control, both arms passing is the desired outcome (the harness's 'dead weight' label does not apply to controls).

annotations_2026_08_03.shape-header-no-turn-hook: Historical context, added after the fact; the recorded rates and costs above are untouched. This arm measured the per-turn hook as it shipped on 2026-07-28: a 785-char reminder (six-shape list + skill routing + evidence rule) injected every turn. On 2026-08-03 that hook was trimmed to a 230-char nudge, partly on this arm's finding that its turn-one contribution was zero. The numbers above therefore describe the larger, pre-trim surface and have not been re-run against the current one.

method_notes: N=3 per arm per case, claude -p cold sessions, model pinned to opus (session default was a limit-exhausted model; inheriting it poisons results).
Scratch projects under $TMPDIR, outside the repo, ORCH_HOME isolated per project.
Pass-rate deltas smaller than a clean sweep are below the documented noise floor (std >=1.5pp at temp 0, arXiv:2602.07150); every non-control case here happened to sweep.
check_cmds rows grade the real filesystem (held-out execution), not prose.
